RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Power cabinet
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: The factory is dark, but the backup circuit still carries a faint charge.

li.label: Repair the circuit
li.description: Replace the burnt contacts and restore controlled power.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Bridge the safety relay
li.description: Power returns at once. The security machines will wake with it.
li.outcome: The security machines are active. Defeat them to secure the supplies.

li.label: Strip the wiring
li.description: Take the copper and leave the cabinet dead.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Pressure manifold
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: Hot coolant knocks against a bank of jammed valves.

li.label: Bleed and reseal
li.description: Fit new seals and recover the metal caught in the filters.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Run an overpressure cycle
li.description: Force the line to flush itself. Its maintenance guard will treat you as an obstruction.
li.outcome: The security machines are active. Defeat them to secure the supplies.

li.label: Drain the coolant
li.description: Bottle what remains. The dry manifold will seize permanently.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Assembly arm
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: A heavy manipulator hangs over an unfinished alloy casting.

li.label: Rebuild the actuator
li.description: Restore the arm and let it finish its last assembly order.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Feed the emergency hopper
li.description: Feed fresh steel into the line. The restarting foundry will summon its guards.
li.outcome: The security machines are active. Defeat them to secure the supplies.

li.label: Cut down the arm
li.description: Recover its frame as scrap. The casting cannot be completed.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Furnace regulator
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: The regulator controls the sealed compartment beneath the furnace.

li.label: Fit a new regulator
li.description: Replace the corroded contacts and open the compartment without a surge.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Override the furnace lock
li.description: Release the lock. The remaining security detail will converge here.
li.outcome: The security machines are active. Defeat them to secure the supplies.

li.label: Cut out the regulator
li.description: Take its components. The sealed instruments will lose their calibration.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Damaged terminal
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: The screen repeats a request for credentials that no longer exist.

li.label: Reconstruct the credentials
li.description: Repair the damaged memory and recover a valid access record.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Restart the security network
li.description: A full restart restores access and wakes the machines watching it.
li.outcome: The security machines are active. Defeat them to secure the supplies.

li.label: Erase the access controller
li.description: Strip the terminal for saleable parts. Its access records are lost.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Medical chamber
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: The chamber still has power. Its instruments have not been sterilized in years.

li.label: Sterilize and recalibrate
li.description: Use fresh medicine to clean the chamber and recover the sealed supplies.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Trigger the emergency release
li.description: Open every compartment. The contaminated-equipment alarm will call the guards.
li.outcome: The security machines are active. Defeat them to secure the supplies.

li.label: Drain the reserve tanks
li.description: Recover fuel from the service tanks and abandon the medical instruments.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Crystal instrument
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: Several misaligned lenses split the instrument beam across the room.

li.label: Align the crystal array
li.description: Replace the worn conductors and bring the readings back into focus.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Rebuild the lens mount
li.description: A steady hand can restore the optics without disturbing the stored data.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Break down the instrument
li.description: Take the alloy casing. The measurements will be lost.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Sealed archive
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: The final storage array is isolated behind an independent security system.

li.label: Restore the archive index
li.description: Repair the storage controller and recover the intact inventory records.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Challenge the security system
li.description: Bypass the lock and defeat the archive guardians.
li.outcome: The security machines are active. Defeat them to secure the supplies.

li.label: Salvage the storage array
li.description: Sellable parts remain, but the records will not survive removal.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Armored entrance
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: A twisted locking bar holds the armory doors shut.

li.label: Replace the locking bar
li.description: Brace the frame and remove the jammed mechanism.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Force the entrance
li.description: The door will open. Its intrusion alarm is still working.
li.outcome: The security machines are active. Defeat them to secure the supplies.

li.label: Strip the outer lockers
li.description: Take what is accessible and destroy the door controls.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Quartermaster terminal
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: An automated quartermaster offers to settle a very old supply account.

li.label: Negotiate a settlement
li.description: Pay a reduced fee and obtain a valid supply receipt.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Repair the account reader
li.description: Recover an unexpired requisition from the damaged reader.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Empty the service racks
li.description: Take the structural steel and abandon the supply account.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Containment station
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: The work station is covered in a chemical residue. A security patrol is docked beside it.

li.label: Decontaminate the station
li.description: Clean the controls and recover the sealed emergency supplies.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Activate the patrol exercise
li.description: Defeat the patrol to obtain its clearance.
li.outcome: The security machines are active. Defeat them to secure the supplies.

li.label: Cut the station feed
li.description: Take the power components and leave the station inert.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.label: Inner armory
RimHex.HexRuinEventDef.description: Two sealed equipment cases remain behind the last inspection gate.

li.label: Service the inspection gate
li.description: Repair the contacts and preserve the cases in their original condition.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.

li.label: Break the security cordon
li.description: The final guard squad must be defeated before the cases can be opened.
li.outcome: The security machines are active. Defeat them to secure the supplies.

li.label: Cut through the storage racks
li.description: Recover the racks as alloy. The delicate contents may not survive.
li.outcome: The work is complete. Recovered supplies have been placed beside the facility.
